Carl explicitly authorized proceeding with the not-null fix after reviewing the tenant-assignment question separately (L10 #18, parked to docs/kb/reference/tenant-operating-model-data-architecture-plan-2026-09-02.md §18 item 14).

False positive, same shape as p4d-18-allow-tenant-less-notification-prefs above: all 5 flagged INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statements are inside the CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION body for swap_tenant_user_to_contact (tenant_contacts insert/update, tenant_users delete, audit_eos_events insert, client_timeline_events insert) - unchanged from the function's existing production behavior, only executed later, per-caller, when a tenant admin actually calls the RPC. Carl explicitly authorized this scoped self-swap-guard hotfix (L10 #31) for review via the standard allowlist path after the scanner flagged the pre-existing function body as new text.

False positive, same shape as l10-31-swap-tenant-user-to-contact-self-guard and p4d-18-allow-tenant-less-notification-prefs above: the flagged 'UPDATE unicorn1.users' statement is inside the CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION body for the new mark_unicorn1_user_mapped(bigint, uuid) RPC - it is not executed at migration-apply time, only later, per-caller, when the mark-unicorn1-user-mapped Edge Function invokes the RPC (gated on FeatureKeys.adminUnicorn1 via requireCaller, same as the existing search_unicorn1_users read-side function this mirrors). Carl explicitly authorized this L10 #33 hotfix in-session (directed applying the migration, reviewing the follow-up PUBLIC-grant-revoke fix, and instructing the merge) before this allowlist entry was added for the standard CI review path.

False positive, same shape as p4d-18/l10-31/l10-33 above: all flagged INSERT/UPDATE statements are inside the CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bodies for start_client_package and transition_membership_state (package_instances/stage_instances/staff_task_instances/client_task_instances/email_instances/document_instances/client_audit_log inserts, package_instance_state_log insert, package_instances/tenants updates) - unchanged from each function's existing production behavior, only executed later, per-caller, when a SuperAdmin/staff user actually calls the RPC. The migration itself performs no direct data mutation; it only adds an app.user_can_access_tenant() authorization check ahead of each existing, unmodified body, revokes SELECT on two views, creates one new read-only SECURITY DEFINER RPC (get_package_burndown), and drops/recreates get_tenant_user_capacity without its spoofable p_caller_id parameter. Carl explicitly authorized all four fixes ("proceed on all four") after independent live re-verification of each finding by both Claude and Codex, then explicitly authorized the merge. See docs/audit-log/entries/2026-09-11-tenant-package-security-fixes.md.
